              更不要拿去倒卖盈利以及在任何地方付费购买
[/color][/b][/size][color=#ff0000][size=4][b]                                      Please do not re upload to any place or pay for purchase.[/b][/size][/color][size=3]

A collection of my hair creations.This way, you don't have to download individual packs (if you want to use all my hair : D).But it maybe will update slowly.

[/size][b][color=#ff0000][size=3]This is a FS module, you need to go to Pierre to buy the hand mirror and get it through the hand mirror.If you have any questions about the FS module, please go to the fashion sense module page for reference.
[/size][/color][/b]
[color=#00ffff][size=4][b]Need[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]SMAPI, Fashion sense[/size]

[color=#00ffff][size=4][b]Install[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]1.Download and install all required.[/size]
[size=3]2.Download the pack and unzip it.[/size]
[size=3]3.Put the folder in "Mods".[/size]

[b][color=#00ffff][size=4]Important[/size][/color][/b]
[size=3]1.This pack fits into another mod of mine. [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7331]click here[/url]
[size=3]2.You could choose to delete them as you like.(Open the "Stardew Valley\Mods\[FS]Kyuya's hairstyles\Hairs",and delete which you dislike.)[/size]
[size=3]3. You can edit this mod [color=#ff7700]for your own use[/color]. But don't upload it anywhere again without my permission.
4. Please do not spend money on modules published by non authors for any reason.[/size]
[size=3]
Thank you for using my module,have fun < 3~
[/size]-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
